selection.fp8_requires: 27 functional,8 reasoning,18 vision,100 strict capacity,30 repeated quality observations all pass

rationale: Do not request 65536 from 64111 measured cache tokens. Retain approximately 6.7K cache-token headroom at 57344 without raising the GPU memory fraction. FP8 is a context/precision tradeoff and need not win short-output speed. Use the already qualified BF16 arm if FP8 quality or strict adherence regresses.
sequence: same managed recipe with only configured max context changed
health/model identity and fresh functional/vision preflight
two-request context scout at 8K and near limit, needle at midpoint
full context: 5 cases x 2 buckets x 3 positions x 2 repetitions = 60
final health, managed status and telemetry

context_controls.thinking: runner uses model template default; no explicit thinking override is forwarded
context_controls.quality_gate: all scored observations correct and normal finish; inspect actual prompt-token coverage
limitations: synthetic retrieval, not full long-document reasoning
separate vision gate does not prove near-limit text-plus-image requests

wall_clock_guard.mechanism: Root records submit time and uses managed context cancel if wall-clock budget expires; retain partial evidence. Never treat timeout_s as aggregate wall-time enforcement.

post_load_observation: cache-capacity-boundary.json corrects any interpretation of the parent16K cache count as a universal physical upper bound. This predeclared selection was conservative; FP8 was rejected on quality before context expansion.
